purpose: Prospective Host-only candidate definitions and independent synthetic holdout, frozen before evaluation
matrix_definition: Bits select full double LN, double-product/double-sum Q/K, double-product/double-sum QK; every stage output rounded to float; V unchanged. Source FP32 epsilon and scale promoted to double. Also evaluate against unchanged legacy double-epsilon reference.
extensions: QK double sum of rounded products
Q/K double sum of rounded products

holdout.kind: independent synthetic, not checkpoint-derived, not actual training trajectory
holdout.generator: uint32 LCG state=1664525*state+1013904223; value=((state>>8)%20001-10000)/10000 in float; order X,dy,gamma,beta,Wq,Wk; no checkpoint parameters
holdout.gradient_generator: For each seed and each head, generate dp then dc; dp scale cycles .25,2,16,64; dc scale alternates .25,4; Cartesian 16*2*8=256 pairs

selection: Evaluate all candidates on frozen 44*2*25 first; select by full joint contract, high precision work, storage and saved-state compatibility. Apply unchanged algorithms to preregistered holdout; no per-case correction or threshold tuning.
device_gate: No prototype unless Host original joint contract and independent validation, saved-state audit, bounded SDK feasibility/cost and safe device all support one candidate. A multi-stage design may stop at feasibility.
